text:
HOLIDAY ASSIGNMENT
 GRADE 4 COMPOSITION
COMPLETE GRADE FOUR HOME ASSIGNMENT
 CRE GRADE 4
 1. My name is . I am in Grade four.
 2. Draw and colour your friend, label and name the different parts of the body in the drawing.
 3. Write a short song on good thoughts and feelings.
 4. Write down five good thoughts that you have.
 5. Write down some of the things that make you happy.
 6. Read and write the following Bible verse from Philippians 4:4.
 7. Look for the meaning of the word ‘emotions’ in the dictionary. Write the meaning.
 8. Draw and colour a happy face.
 9. List some of the results of making wrong choices.
 10. People call you by your
 11. We are fearfully and made by God.
 12. God created us male and
 13. Who is the head of the family?
 14. The sister of my mother or father is my?
 15. The mother of my mother or my father is called?
 16. is the brother of my father or mother.
 17. The children of my uncles are my?
 18. Write down ways in which you protect yourself from sexual abuse.
 19. List four qualities of God that you know.
 20. Name five things that were created by God.
 21. The Bible is divided into parts.
 22. The Old Testament has books while the New Testament has
 books.
 23. Explain ways in which you can show respect to the Bible.
 24. Write down four reasons why it is important to read the Bible.
 25. Match the names of the books of the Bible listed below with where each one is found.
 a 2nd Samuel Old Testament
 b Ezra New Testament
 c Galatians Old Testament
 d Zephaniah Old Testament
